Care principles & sources

Identification matters. Several IDs are provisional. Verify uncertain plants before species-specific pruning or treatment. Soil-test first, and never fertilize a drought-stressed, diseased, or unidentified plant simply to green it up.

How this catalog should be used

Use filters to focus on a season, plant type, or priority. Open any card for the complete care plan. Address the stressed conifer first, then verify the medium- and low-confidence identifications.

Photo note: Each card shows a representative photo of the species/cultivar for identification reference. These illustrate what the plant typically looks like and are not photos of your specific plants; always confirm identification against your own garden photos before species-specific treatment.
